Grants access to the reaction command 'Ravenous Saber', a deadly 5-hit combo of elemental fury! Deals more damage with $(l:kingdomkeys:abilities/spellblade)Spellblade$(/l) equipped. $(p)Grants access to Gaze Form.
This form specializes in heavy hitting attacks imbued with the power of the elements. $(p)$(item)Exclusive$() to the $(l:kingdomkeys:keyblades/gazing_omen)Gazing Omen$(/l) keyblade.
